verdict.rationale: Firstbase clearly offers a company-formation product (evidenced by the /incorporate-your-company URL and related account/banking setup features), and a community anecdote confirms users have used it to set up a US entity. However, no evidence explicitly describes Delaware-specific filing, bylaws generation, or initial board approval workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Delaware filing steps, bylaws templates/generation, and board consent/approval process.
